extracted.name: Roasted radishes
extracted.description: Add a pop of colour to your Easter roast with these jewel-like radishes. Use a mixture of radishes in different colours, if you can, for a touch of spring
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Tip the radishes and bashed garlic cloves into a roasting tin, season well and drizzle with the oil. Toss to coat the radishes and garlic.
Roast for 30-40 mins, or until the radishes are tender. Squeeze the garlic from its skins, then stir gently and serve.
